newsitem.title: CHINA: Pledged foreign investment in Beijing $20 bln.
newsitem.headline: Pledged foreign investment in Beijing $20 bln.

text.p: Chinese authorities in Beijing have approved the establishment of 12,845 foreign-funded enterprises between 1979 and end-April this year, the Securities Daily said on Wednesday.
Pledged foreign investment since China opened its doors to foreign funds in 1979 totalled $20.017 billion, the newspaper said.
Exports of the capital's foreign-funded enterprises were $810 million in 1996, accounting for 34.46 percent of the city's total exports, it said without giving comparative figures.

Foreign-funded firms paid 3.5 billion yuan ($421.7 million) in taxes in 1996, accounting for 19.7 percent of total industrial and commericial taxes collected, the newspaper said without giving further details.
